fields.name: SYMBOL
fields.description: Security identifier from the daily quote table.
boundaryTests: base key is always selected

fields.name: TRADE_DATE
fields.description: Trading date from the daily quote table.
boundaryTests: target date is filtered only in final layer

fields.name: OPEN
boundaryTests: adjustment mode rewrites qfq/hfq/raw columns

fields.name: HIGH
boundaryTests: usable in numeric comparisons

fields.name: LOW
boundaryTests: usable in numeric comparisons

fields.name: CLOSE
boundaryTests: window indicators expand scan range before final filtering

fields.name: VOLUME
boundaryTests: zero volume remains a valid numeric value

fields.name: AMOUNT
boundaryTests: large values are compared through bound parameters

fields.name: TURNOVER_RATE
boundaryTests: valid ORDER BY scalar on target date

fields.name: MARKET
fields.description: Market category such as SH or SZ.
boundaryTests: IN-list values are parameterized

functions.name: MA
functions.description: N-trading-day moving average partitioned by security and ordered by trade date.
boundaryTests: window must be an integer literal
window range is 1..5000

functions.name: EMA
functions.description: Exponential moving average with alpha=2/(N+1), seeded from the first observed value; compilation requires recursive lowering or a versioned precomputed feature.
boundaryTests: known sequence follows the recursive EMA formula
unsupported lowering fails instead of degrading to MA

functions.name: CROSS_UP
functions.description: True when the left ordered series crosses above the right ordered series on the target date.
boundaryTests: operands must be sortable series
adds one extra lookback day for LAG

functions.name: CROSS_DOWN
functions.description: True when the left ordered series crosses below the right ordered series on the target date.
boundaryTests: operands must be sortable series
adds one extra lookback day for LAG

functions.name: PE_TTM
functions.description: TTM price earnings ratio using point-in-time announced financial visibility.
boundaryTests: joins by visible_from/visible_to instead of report_period

functions.name: PB
functions.description: Price to book ratio using point-in-time announced financial visibility.
boundaryTests: joins by visible_from/visible_to instead of report_period

functions.name: PS_TTM
functions.description: TTM price sales ratio using point-in-time announced financial visibility.
boundaryTests: joins by visible_from/visible_to instead of report_period

functions.name: ROE_TTM
functions.description: TTM return on equity using point-in-time announced financial visibility.
boundaryTests: percent comparison such as ROE_TTM() >= 15% is valid

functions.name: ROA_TTM
functions.description: TTM return on assets using point-in-time announced financial visibility.
boundaryTests: joins by visible_from/visible_to instead of report_period

functions.name: NET_PROFIT_YOY
functions.description: Year-over-year net profit growth using point-in-time announced financial visibility.
boundaryTests: negative growth remains comparable

functions.name: VOLATILITY
functions.description: N-trading-day sample standard deviation for volatility-style screening.
boundaryTests: window must be an integer literal
window range is 1..5000

functions.name: STDDEV
functions.description: N-trading-day sample standard deviation over a numeric series.
boundaryTests: window must be an integer literal
window range is 1..5000

functions.name: RETURN_N
functions.description: N-trading-day return: current value divided by N-day lagged value minus one.
boundaryTests: uses N-day LAG
scan range expands before final date filtering

functions.name: RSI
functions.description: Relative strength index over an ordered price series.
boundaryTests: window must be an integer literal
scan range expands before final date filtering

functions.name: RANK_BY
functions.description: Cross-sectional descending dense rank on each trade date.
boundaryTests: partitioned by trade_date
valid ORDER BY scalar on target date

functions.name: PERCENTILE_RANK
functions.description: Cross-sectional percentile rank on each trade date.
boundaryTests: partitioned by trade_date
valid ORDER BY scalar on target date

functions.name: ABS
functions.description: Absolute value helper for template-based indicators and rules.
boundaryTests: template arguments are rendered through controlled expression lowering
